## Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing page hero, Pebblebrook Tea Co. (UK). Timing was not given.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | On the policy list (review export, Oct 2026). Exact wording, so it is fine. |
| The finest organic loose leaf | **"finest"** is a banned superlative (section 3). "Organic" is backed by the Soil Association certificate, but should use the certified wording. |
| eco-friendly bags | **"eco-friendly"** is a banned general green claim (section 3). The provable version is "plastic-free and home compostable" (EN 13432 certificate). |
| packed by hand in Bristol | On the policy list ("Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol"). |

**Regulated claims:** the environmental line is the only risk. The broad "eco-friendly" wording is the kind regulators challenge most.

**House style:** no banned words, and the voice is plain. The superlative "finest" is the one copy-level problem. Score is about 75 before the fixes and about 90 after.

**Disclosure:** nothing needed. This is the brand's own page, with no partnership, affiliate link or AI-content label.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite):**
> Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic loose leaf tea and plastic-free, home compostable tea bags, packed by hand in Bristol.

- "finest" is removed.
- "organic" now says "Certified organic". If you want to name the certifier, use "Certified organic by the Soil Association".
- "eco-friendly" is replaced with the specific plastic-free and home compostable claim.
- "Packed by hand in Bristol" is kept. The policy covers tins, so it is safest as "Every tin packed by hand in Bristol" if the bags are packed differently. Please confirm with operations.

**Needs a decision:** whether the hand-packed claim covers the tea bags as well as the tins. My suggestion is to say "Every tin" unless operations confirms.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Nothing is approved yet. The rewrite is a new version, so Sam needs to say yes to this exact final text before it goes live.

**Evidence log rows (2026-11-17, landing hero):**
- 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website: policy list, review export Oct 2026
- Certified organic: policy list, Soil Association certificate (renewed 2026)
- Plastic-free and home compostable tea bags: policy list, EN 13432 supplier certificate
- Packed by hand in Bristol: policy list, Operations
- "finest" and "eco-friendly": removed, unproven and banned
